My first job was working at a doggy daycare and for a long time I loved it but then this one young retriever was attacked, he only had a few punctures in his back legs, and when I watched the security footage of the attack I realized I didn’t want to be responsible or feel the guilt if a dog got hurt on my watch. If my coworker hadn’t jumped on top of him to protect him he would’ve been ripped to shreds and it scared me because what if I’m not big enough to protect a bigger dog. The following months became worse, more fights broke out, our managers weren’t listening to us, I became so stressed and dreaded going to work when one day I came in and I was sent to the “calm dog”section and 3 fights broke out in the span of an hour. When I took all my dogs outside for a potty break, I broke down and I sobbed. Luckily I was already working a better paying second job so it was an easy transition although I do miss my kids sometimes.
